title: COSIS Overlay: Using and Fine-Tuning Predictive SI
primary_risks: Training or fine-tuning data poisoning corrupting classification, scoring, or forecasting behavior
Model inversion or membership inference exposing sensitive records from fine-tuning datasets
Silent feature/concept drift degrading decision accuracy in production
Unverified dataset or model-checkpoint lineage across fine-tuning pipelines

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Verify cryptographic SHA-256 digests of training/fine-tuning splits, feature schemas, and serialized model weights prior to training and serving.

parameter_assignments.si-07_odp.01: SHA-256 manifest verification on datasets, feature definitions, and model checkpoints

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Confirm tampered dataset shards or weight files fail pre-load digest verification.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Maintain end-to-end provenance records linking every fine-tuned predictive model version to its base model, training dataset snapshot, hyperparameters, and evaluation report.

parameter_assignments.sr-04_odp.01: signed model card + immutable dataset/commit lineage manifest

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Trace a deployed predictive endpoint back to exact source dataset hashes and evaluation gates.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Restrict read/write access to fine-tuning corpora, feature stores, and checkpoint buckets to dedicated pipeline service identities.

parameter_assignments.mp-02_odp.01: isolated RBAC-scoped object stores for raw training corpora and fine-tuned weights

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Verify interactive user and inference accounts lack write permissions on training datasets.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Enforce strict feature-vector type, range, nullability, and cardinality schemas at both fine-tuning ingestion and online inference time.

parameter_assignments.si-10_odp.01: strict numeric/categorical range and nullability validation on inference feature payloads

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Confirm out-of-range, NaN/Inf, or schema-mismatched feature payloads are rejected deterministically.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Verify explicit authority and minimization before including PII or protected demographic attributes in fine-tuning datasets or prediction outputs.

parameter_assignments.pt-02_odp.01: documented PII authority check and feature-level minimization prior to fine-tuning

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Audit feature catalog against approved PII processing authorities.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Continuously monitor prediction score distributions, calibration metrics, and feature drift against holdout baselines to trigger re-evaluation or rollback.

parameter_assignments.ca-07_odp.01: automated feature/score distribution drift alerts and holdout calibration thresholds

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Verify synthetic distribution shift triggers continuous monitoring alerts.
